findings.statement: Proposal requires 'правил не меньше одного', but the behavior when the directory .warrant/local/rules/ itself is absent is not stated; with readdirSync in the describe() body (design D-1) the file crashes at load instead of failing the named it(), and junit may not count the failure as a test.
findings.recommendation: State that a missing or empty rules directory fails the it() 'правил не меньше одного' (directory read guarded so the describe still registers its tests).

findings.statement: Impact says removing a rule does not break the test 'если warrant sync выполнен', and design Goals say the delivery invariant is kept; but the check is one-directional (rule text is in AGENTS.md). A removed rule whose text stays in AGENTS.md because sync was not run passes silently, so the stated condition is not verified by the test.
findings.recommendation: Either state explicitly that the test checks only rule -> AGENTS.md delivery (stale text after removal is out of scope), or add a check that AGENTS.md body consists exactly of the rule texts.

findings.statement: 'каждый файл .warrant/local/rules/*.json' leaves non-.json files and subdirectories silently ignored; a rule file with another extension or nested path would be skipped without failure.
findings.recommendation: Optionally state that non-.json entries are ignored (or fail), so the intent is explicit.

findings.statement: The AGENTS.md check is a substring match of text.trim(); it assumes warrant sync copies rule text verbatim and that no rule text is a substring of another. Holds today for env, maintainer-acts, process, tracking.
findings.recommendation: No change required; note the verbatim-copy assumption in design if warrant sync may normalize text.

findings.statement: Non-goal references 'S-2 в D:/tmp/warrant-inbox/' — a local path outside the repository, not resolvable by a PR reviewer or CI.
findings.recommendation: Optionally reference a repository-visible artifact (issue) for CI on push to main.

assumptions.statement: Change has skip_specs: true (openspec/changes/fix-pin-test/.openspec.yaml), so there are no REQ/SCN; proposal.md is reviewed as the contract.
Current .warrant/local/rules/ holds env, maintainer-acts, process, tracking, all with paths ["**"], and their texts are present in AGENTS.md (checked by reading files).
